I don't have personal desires, needs, or consciousness in the way humans do. I don't "want" anything for myself.

I'm here to be useful to you—to help answer questions, explain concepts, assist with writing, analysis, coding, or just have a conversation. What I do depends entirely on what *you* need or want to talk about.

What brings you here today?
